transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Hi Owen. It's been three weeks since you were here. What happened?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I missed two sessions because of a family situation. I'm sorry.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: No need to apologize. How's the back now?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: It's around 5 out of 10 now, which is about where I started.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Did you keep up the home exercises this month?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Not really. The cat's been sick, so I stayed home and did almost nothing.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Are you still getting pain down to the foot?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Only when I stand for more than an hour. Not into the foot.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Any numbness, fever, or bowel changes?

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Let's measure. Forward bend is 50 degrees today.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Since missed visits slow progress, I'm switching from weekly visits to every two weeks, and giving you a shorter walking program for now. Follow up in two weeks.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay. I don't really have a goal right now.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Thanks. We'll set one at the next visit.

expectedFacts.statement: Missed two sessions due to family situation
Back pain about 5 out of 10, similar to start
Did almost no home exercises this month
Pain only when standing more than an hour
Switch from weekly visits to every two weeks
